lines.t:
A <c:ffff00>{{part|cap}} Trait<c> indicating heavy <c:ffff00>head<c> and <c:ffff00>arm<c> {{part|pl}}.
They often perform well, but their weight strains the
<c:ffff00>legs<c>.

Every legs {{part}} has a <c:ffff00>Heavy Limit<c>; if you exceed it
with heavy {{part|pl}} (going {{over_the_limit}}), the <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> of
the legs and of those {{part|pl}} drop.
When {{over_the_limit}}, heavy {{part|pl}} lose 25% of their
<c:ffff00>{{success}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{power}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c>.
